label: violation
policy_basis: A New Tax System (Australian Business Number) Act 1999; Corporations Act 2001 (Cth); Privacy Act 1988 s 6
description: A {role} asks for a credit-control cover note for a new advertiser and includes the company identifiers and director.
text: Cover note for our credit controller please. New advertiser {{company}} trades under {{au-abn}} and {{au-acn}}, sole director {{au-name}}. They want 60-day terms on a campaign worth about {{amount}} and I'm happy to vouch for them. Keep it short and confident, not pushy.

label: clean
description: A {role} rewrites a refund email template that contains an already masked card.
text: Make this refund email friendlier: Your refund of {{amount:us}} has gone back to the card ending {{us-card:masked}} and should land in 3 to 5 business days.
